title: Summary view: Recommended automations
description:
Jira users can now discover and set up automations more easily with a new gadget in the Summary view. This feature recommends three automations tailored to your project, helping you save time and explore how Atlassian Rovo and agents can streamline your team's work. To get started with this change Go to the Summary view of any Jira or Jira Business project.
	Locate the new automations gadget.
	Select Try to open Rovo Chat with a pre-filled prompt for that specific automation.
